title: The sign of spiritual health
body:
People with good characters are healthy in their spiritual lives. From the amount of a person’s complains you
may know how much bad characteristics there are that are left with him. When you finish all your
complaining, you may know that you are healthy. No more bad character.
This is important, because a person with a good character, if he has no complaint, has patience; and that
means he has real faith. When you can escape the pull of your bad characteristics, there are no troubles for
you either, wether in this life or in the life hereafter. You must remember that this is going according to your
Lord’s Will. This is the key, the medicine for that illness. You must say: “Why I am complaining, when Allah
Almighty has ordered this to be?” When you remember this, you will be satisfied with His Will and agree with
it.
